title: Napoleonic Wars
summary: Napoleon Bonaparte redrew the map of Europe in two decades of campaigns before his final defeat at Waterloo.

stories.title: Napoleon's Campaigns
stories.summary: Five battles that defined the rise and fall of the French Empire.

events.title: Austerlitz
events.body: Napoleon lured Austrian and Russian armies onto ground of his choosing and shattered them in the Battle of the Three Emperors. The victory secured French dominance in central Europe.

events.title: Jena
events.body: French forces crushed the Prussian army in a single day. The twin victories at Jena and Auerstedt dissolved Prussia as a great power for years.

events.title: Invasion of Russia
events.body: The Grande Armée marched deep into Russia. Moscow burned, supply lines collapsed, and the retreat through winter destroyed an army of half a million men.

events.title: Leipzig
events.body: Coalition armies converged on Leipzig in the largest battle of the Napoleonic Wars. Napoleon's defeat forced a retreat across the Rhine.

events.title: Waterloo
events.body: Returned from exile, Napoleon struck at the Anglo-Allied and Prussian armies in Belgium. Wellington and Blücher held and counter-attacked, ending the Hundred Days.

stories.title: The Peninsular War
stories.summary: Spain bleeds the French Empire in a war of occupation and guerrilla.
